memberships_scope_shape.name: memberships_scope_shape
memberships_scope_shape.value:
CASE "memberships"."scope_type"
        WHEN 'platform'   THEN "memberships"."brand_id" IS NULL AND "memberships"."franchisee_id" IS NULL AND "memberships"."branch_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'brand'      THEN "memberships"."brand_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memberships"."franchisee_id" IS NULL AND "memberships"."branch_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'franchisee' THEN "memberships"."brand_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memberships"."franchisee_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memberships"."branch_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'branch'     THEN "memberships"."brand_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memberships"."franchisee_id" IS NULL AND "memberships"."branch_id" IS NOT NULL
      END

staff_invitations_scope_shape.name: staff_invitations_scope_shape
staff_invitations_scope_shape.value:
CASE "staff_invitations"."scope_type"
        WHEN 'platform'   THEN "staff_invitations"."brand_id" IS NULL AND "staff_invitations"."franchisee_id" IS NULL AND "staff_invitations"."branch_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'brand'      THEN "staff_invitations"."brand_id" IS NOT NULL AND "staff_invitations"."franchisee_id" IS NULL AND "staff_invitations"."branch_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'franchisee' THEN "staff_invitations"."brand_id" IS NOT NULL AND "staff_invitations"."franchisee_id" IS NOT NULL AND "staff_invitations"."branch_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'branch'     THEN "staff_invitations"."brand_id" IS NOT NULL AND "staff_invitations"."franchisee_id" IS NULL AND "staff_invitations"."branch_id" IS NOT NULL
      END

pog_bounds.name: pog_bounds
pog_bounds.value: ("product_option_groups"."min_select" IS NULL OR "product_option_groups"."min_select" >= 0) AND ("product_option_groups"."max_select" IS NULL OR "product_option_groups"."max_select" >= 1)

product_variants_bounds.name: product_variants_bounds
product_variants_bounds.value: ("product_variants"."min_price_minor" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."min_price_minor" <= "product_variants"."price_minor") AND ("product_variants"."max_price_minor" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."max_price_minor" >= "product_variants"."price_minor")
